Frequently Asked Questions

What are the signs of a bad refrigerator compressor? +

Common signs include your refrigerator not cooling properly, the compressor making a loud or unusual humming or buzzing noise, the fridge tripping your circuit breaker, or the compressor motor feeling excessively hot to the touch. If you notice any of these, you need urgent refrigerator repair in Vadodara.

How much does refrigerator compressor repair cost in Vadodara? +

The refrigerator compressor repair cost in Vadodara can vary depending on the brand, model, and the extent of the damage. A minor repair might cost between ₹1,500 – ₹3,000, while a full refrigerator compressor replacement cost in Vadodara could range from ₹4,500 to ₹10,000+. We provide a transparent quote before starting any work.

Do you offer a warranty on fridge compressor repairs? +

Yes, absolutely! We provide a 3-month guarantee on all our services and any parts we replace, including compressors. We stand by the quality of our work for your peace of mind.

Do you repair inverter refrigerator compressors? +

Yes, we specialize in inverter refrigerator compressor repair. Our certified technicians are trained to handle the complex electronics of modern inverter fridges from all major brands.

How quickly can you repair my refrigerator? +

We pride ourselves on offering same-day refrigerator compressor repair in Vadodara. We understand the urgency and aim to diagnose and fix the issue within hours of your call.

My Samsung fridge compressor has a warranty. How does that work? +

While the Samsung fridge compressor warranty often covers the part itself for up to 10 or 20 years, it typically does not cover labor, gas refilling, or other service charges. We provide a faster, independent service and can advise if a warranty claim is your best option.

Why is my fridge leaking water? +

A refrigerator leaking water in Vadodara is usually due to a clogged defrost drain, a cracked drain pan, or a faulty water inlet valve. While not always a compressor issue, it’s something our technicians can fix quickly.

What are your refrigerator gas filling charges in Vadodara? +

Our refrigerator gas filling charges in Vadodara typically range from ₹1,200 to ₹2,500, depending on the type of refrigerant (like R600a or R134a) and your fridge model.

Is it better to repair or replace my old fridge? +

If your refrigerator is less than 8-10 years old, repairing the compressor is usually much more cost-effective than buying a new appliance. A repair can extend its life for several more years. We’ll give you an honest assessment to help you make the best choice.
